entries.013d98df8b6d3629: Customers are medical facilities that provide comprehensive medical checkups and health screenings and their examinees; companies, health insurance societies and local governments also use the booking systems.
entries.1eedcc9d71ec01b9: This is the provision of WEB reservation systems that contribute to operational efficiency, such as "MRSO-Plus," a cloud-based health screening reservation management service for medical facilities, "Health Plus," a health screening operations support service for health insurance associations and companies, and "MRSO Business," a health management DX service, as well as resident health screening WEB reservation systems for municipalities.
entries.3852c1b27a18e56d: The Management Policy, Business Environment and Issues to Be Addressed section states that the health screening and comprehensive medical checkup market size was ¥981.0 billion in fiscal 2023 (survey by Yano Research Institute Ltd.), and that the share of non-examinees for comprehensive medical checkups and health screenings was 29.9% (Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare, 'Comprehensive Survey of Living Conditions, 2022').
entries.3b08a141f64aa6ff: Revenue from performance-based fees and system usage fees
entries.3fafcc73f343a4c3: It aims to extend healthy life expectancy by 8 years (+8Y), and states that through healthcare DX with preventive medicine as its entry point, it will connect individuals, companies, government and medical facilities to update preventive medicine.
entries.45ffc890e8bdb352: This is a single-segment business that provides a reservation platform for comprehensive medical checkups and health examinations, and reservation systems for medical facilities, corporations and government bodies. The group consists of the company and 1 consolidated subsidiary (MRSO ASIA Co.,Ltd., Hanoi, Vietnam). Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥1,078 million, and the number of consolidated employees was 25. Sales are managed by category according to the services provided: "Reservations," "Advertising," "DX" and "Vaccines." The WEB reservation system for vaccination has effectively ended its provision as local governments' vaccination programs have ended.
entries.4f62248ba13135a7: MRSO Inc. is headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, and conducts its business together with its consolidated subsidiary MRSO ASIA Co.,Ltd. in Hanoi, Vietnam.

entries.5dbcc8bb8ae1d2b0: This business expands the exposure of medical facilities through feature pages on 'MRSO.jp' and the like, and carries out promotions on 'MRSO.jp' through partnerships with companies.
entries.5eb4ff0aaa234179: The health screening and comprehensive medical checkup market is put at ¥981.0 billion for fiscal 2023, and since 29.9% of eligible people aged 20 and over are non-examinees, it is positioned in an area with substantial room for digitalization of examinations and expansion of examinees.
entries.65a1d84f362776a1: 'MRSO.jp' lists comprehensive medical checkup and health screening plans from 1,906 medical facilities as of the end of December 2025, and its distinguishing feature is that, built on a booking media with the largest scale in Japan in terms of listed medical facilities, it provides the booking system 'MRS' for medical facilities as an integrated offering.
entries.6d21fb112444a915: This consists of providing WEB reservation systems that contribute to operational efficiency, including "MRSO-Plus," a cloud-based checkup reservation management service for medical facilities, "Health Plus," a checkup operations support service for health insurance societies and companies, the health management DX service "MRSO Business," and WEB reservation systems for resident health checkups for municipalities. Sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥163 million.

entries.eaba151efe7faeac: It aims to extend healthy life expectancy by 8 years (+8Y), and states that through healthcare DX with preventive medicine as its entry point, it will connect individuals, companies, government and medical facilities to update preventive medicine. It positions corporate booking, which full-scale launched in April 2025, as a future growth area and states that it aims to expand the business.
entries.fe7bd197bf6e1101: This is the provision of WEB reservation systems for novel coronavirus vaccination and similar purposes. Because local governments' vaccination programs ended following changes in the national vaccination policy, provision of the service has effectively ended, and its share of sales in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was only 0.1%.
